reasoning_content:
Next, as per the documentation, run the documented command:
`poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl > results.jsonl`

This will end up checking 46 distribution URLs against files that actually exist (image.jpeg, correct.json, etc.) and some invalid ones. It could take a little while — some checks involve downloading and validating files. Let's set a reasonable timeout and run it in the background.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup python3 -m poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl > /tmp/results.jsonl 2>/tmp/results.stderr.log &
echo "started $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && nohup python3 -m poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --url http://localhost:8000/catalog.ttl > /tmp/results.jsonl 2>/tmp/results.stderr.log &\necho \"started $!\"", "summary": "Run dcat_catalog_check.py on local catalog", "security_risk": "LOW"}
